name: bot_stacks_through_its_orders
description: The plan bot (tests/bot.gd) can stack its plan's waves through the game's own input route (M8, contract-m8 §7 and §9): with `stacking` on, in High Water alone the Lamplighter calls the waves its plan's stack list names (2 and 3) during the wave before, as the caretaker would (Caretaker.wants_stack: its builds it can pay for done), by two presses of the build controller's horn, the second sending it; each call goes out as a READY 1 of seat 1 during a wave through the turns, the stacked horn sounds as it lands and the waves walk the road together, and the bot says each call (`stack wave 2 seq N`). Off unless asked: a bot without it never says Ready, so bot_wins_classic and the smokes play as before.

steps.msg: it called wave 2 during wave 1: two waves on the road
one READY 1 of seat 1 went through the turns: the first press sent nothing, the second the call

steps.assert: ' | '.join(bot.log).contains('stack wave 2 seq ') and not ' | '.join(bot.log).contains('stack wave 2 seq -1')
steps.msg: the bot says the call with its seq
and wave 3 during wave 2, the plan's whole list
no wave its list does not name: wave 4 and 5 came from their windows
